name: @pipeworx/mcp-bible

tools.name: get_verse
tools.description: Get a specific Bible verse or range by reference (e.g., "john 3:16", "romans 8:28", "psalm 23:1-6"). Returns verse text in World English Bible translation.

reference.description: Bible reference string (e.g. "john 3:16", "genesis 1:1-3", "psalm 23"). Spaces will be encoded automatically.

tools.name: get_passage
tools.description: Get a Bible passage in your choice of translation (KJV, WEB, OEB, BBE, Cherokee, DRA, and more). Returns full text with reference and translation metadata.

tools.name: random_verse
tools.description: Fetch a random Bible verse from the World English Bible (WEB) translation. Returns the reference, full verse text, translation ID, and per-verse breakdown with book, chapter, and verse number.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bible forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bible pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
